In most cases, a primary key uniquely identifies an Entity. You can delete Entities by setting their primary keys in the delete request. The example code below demonstrates how to delete two entities with primary keys

export CLUSTER_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:19530"
export TOKEN="root:Milvus"

curl --request POST \
--url "${CLUSTER_ENDPOINT}/v2/vectordb/entities/delete" \
--header "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
--header "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{
    "collectionName": "quick_setup",
    "filter": "id in [18, 19]"
}'
You can also delete entities stored in specific partitions. The following code snippets assume that you have a partition named

res = client.delete(
    collection_name="quick_setup",
    ids=[18, 19],
    partition_name="partitionA"
)

print(res)
